metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates the Turtle Exercise — a simple daily move that can help improve forward head posture and reduce a neck hump.

This exercise can be done at home (or at work), requires no equipment, and may provide noticeable results even after the first session.

Let us know how it works for you!
